To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the leadership style of transformational leadership has significant positive relationship with extraversion and agreeableness, and negative relationship with neuroticism; (2) the leadership style transactional leadership has significant negative relationship with neurotisism; (3) the leadership style laissez-faire leadership has significant negative relationships with extraversion and conscientiousness; (4) the leadership style charismatic leadership has significant positive relationships with extraversion, agreeableness, openness, and conscientiousness and
the leadership style of transformational leadership is positively correlated with openness to experience and extraversion.
